description.narrative:
The EU NIP investment grant would leverage EBRD¿s loans and would play a crucial role in achieving the Ganja Water and Wastewater Project¿s objectives. The EU NIP grant co-financing is crucial for ensuring that the Project achieves its full potential and adhering to international standards. This support will ensure that the infrastructure improvements are not only effective but also sustainable and resilient, providing long-term benefits to Ganja.

Improved water supply and wastewater systems will ensure that residents have access to clean and safe drinking water, reducing the incidence of waterborne diseases and enhancing overall public health. Modern wastewater collection network will significantly reduce the leakage of pollutants into groundwater resources, avoiding soil pollution, protecting aquatic ecosystems and contributing to the sustainability of natural resources. Moreover, upgraded infrastructure can stimulate local economies by creating jobs during the construction phase and by providing reliable services that attract businesses and investors to the city.

This EU contribution is fostering sustainable development and bolstering regional stability. By enhancing infrastructure, this Project will improve local services and will attract further investment, contributing to economic growth and improving quality of life for residents.

The EU grant incentivises the implementation of best available technologies and practices, ensuring the Project's alignment with EU standards. The investment grant will increase the whole water sector¿s sustainability through promoting the implementation of more transparent utility practices. This support is essential for achieving sustainable water management and improving the quality of life for residents in Ganja city.
